data.ScriptBlockText: Write-Host '[1] Software Discovery...'; Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\* | Select-Object DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Host '[2] Directory Enum...'; foreach ($p in @('C:\Users')) { Get-ChildItem -Path $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-File C:\sigmacatch\enum.txt -append }; Write-Host '[3] Bookmarks...'; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Path 'C:\Users\frack113\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default' -Filter Bookmarks -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Force | Out-Null; Write-Host '[4] Service ACL...'; Get-Acl 'REGISTRY::HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\' | Out-Null; Write-Host '=== Done ==='
